title: Identifying Parallel Inheritance Hierarchies
question: Which of the following statements best describes the 'Parallel Inheritance Hierarchies' code smell?

options.text: Whenever you create a subclass for a class, you find yourself needing to create a subclass for another class.
A method is filled with explanatory comments.
Two code fragments look almost identical.
A class doesn't do enough to earn your attention and should be deleted.

explanation: Parallel Inheritance Hierarchies occur when you have two class hierarchies that mirror each other, and every time you make a change in one, you have to make a corresponding change in the other. This often indicates that the two hierarchies should be merged or redesigned.
